notes: The v6 driver and matching helper passed independent ELF and embedded-code inspection before import.
Embedded AIDL Effect V4/common V5 and legacy AELI share one driver; control protocol remains 3.
Android factory compatibility, SELinux behavior and real audio processing remain unverified for this build.
Soundstage preserves unity mid while side width spans 0.8..1.25x across the unchanged UI 30..75; width 50 is exact bypass, with no filter, delay or nonlinear envelope.

The DSP setter, legacy parameter 1500, global service and matching helper support finite -30..+30 dB post-gain. APK/client/UI remain unchanged for a later app-specific update; no user preference or live gain was changed.

Strict/fast-math/sanitizer suites and real DSP host gain tests passed. The isolated kernel Binder test was skipped because its dedicated host environment was not provisioned; this does not validate Android transport or listening.
The centre attenuation in beta 6.4 is deliberately removed. Compare at comfortable volume; unchanged limiting can still affect boosted or high-level output.
